bio_en: Grish Khan (Grigor Ter-Danielian) was born in 1887 in the village of Talish in the Jraberd district of Karabakh, the youngest son of an influential villager, and studied at the gymnasium in Ganja until 1905. After failing to join the fighting bands, he left home for Baku in 1906 and stayed there until 1908, when the revolution broke out in Persia. From 1909 he fought in nearly all the major battles of the Persian constitutional revolution as Yeprem's inseparable comrade-in-arms, and continued to serve after Yeprem's death. He married in 1912, regarded Iran as his second homeland, and died early in 1933.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death year from the obituary date (Alik, 12 Feb 1933); exact date of death not stated. His memoirs were published in Hairenik monthly.
